items.situation: expressing concern about a friend's situation
items.speaker: You've barely said a word since the meeting.

options.A: I'd rather not get into it.
options.B: The meeting room was freezing today.
options.C: She said a few words at lunch.
options.D: Yes, I signed the attendance sheet.

items.explanation: 正确答案是A。说话人关心地指出对方一直没出声，A用地道的口语说法委婉表示「不想谈这件事」，是自然的回应（idiomatic）。B是语义联想陷阱，抓住 meeting 转去说会议室很冷，答非所问（semantic_association_trap）。C换了主语说别人，与对方的沉默无关（off_topic）。D回答的是「有没有签到」这种完全不同的问题（wrong_question_type）。

items.situation: checking if a service (post office, bank) is open
items.speaker: Why's the post office closed on a Tuesday?

options.A: I mailed the package last week.
options.B: Actually, they switched to winter hours.
options.C: Yes, it's right across the street.
options.D: The bank stays open until five.

items.explanation: 正确答案是B。以话语标记 Actually 开头，间接给出原因——改成冬季营业时间了（marker_led_indirect）。A由 post office 联想到寄包裹，说的是上周自己的事，没有回答原因（semantic_association_trap）。C回答的是「在哪儿」而不是「为什么」（wrong_question_type）。D换成银行，是另一个话题（off_topic）。

items.situation: student asking a professor about office hours or assignment
items.speaker: How much detail's needed in the summary?

options.A: The summary is due on Friday.
options.B: Yes, detail matters a great deal.
options.C: How long's your draft so far?
options.D: I haven't printed the syllabus yet.

items.explanation: 正确答案是C。老师用一个反问推进对话，先了解学生初稿的长度再给建议（counter_question）。A由 summary 联想到截止日期，回答的不是详略程度（semantic_association_trap）。B用 Yes 回答了一个本来就不是是非问的问题（wrong_question_type）。D说的是教学大纲打印，与提问无关（off_topic）。

items.situation: student asking about a campus event or concert
items.speaker: I can't find anywhere to buy tickets for the concert.

options.A: The concert starts at eight sharp.
options.B: I bought that album last spring.
options.C: No, I can't find my wallet.

items.explanation: 正确答案是D。对方不去回答「哪里买票」，而是直接解决问题——我这儿多一张票给你（context_shift）。A由 concert 联想到开场时间，帮不上忙（semantic_association_trap）。B说的是买专辑，是另一个场景（off_topic）。C误解了 can't find，把找不到票听成找不到钱包（misinterpretation）。

items.situation: offering help to someone who seems stressed
items.speaker: Don't you want me to take the late shift?

options.A: Could you grab that box instead?
options.B: The late shift ends around eleven.
options.C: Yes, she took it last night.
options.D: I don't want anything to eat.

items.explanation: 正确答案是A。被关心的人不正面回答要不要人替班，而是说出真正需要的帮助，把话题转到眼下更要紧的事上（context_shift）。B由 late shift 联想到下班时间，只是陈述事实（semantic_association_trap）。C换了个人说昨晚的事，与眼下的提议无关（off_topic）。D误解了 want，当成想不想吃东西（misinterpretation）。

items.situation: student asking about course enrollment or prerequisites
items.speaker: What's the prerequisite for taking statistics?

options.A: Statistics meets in the science building.
options.B: Well, the intro course covers that.
options.C: Yes, you're allowed to enroll early.
options.D: I finished my registration on Monday.

items.explanation: 正确答案是B。以 Well 开头，间接告诉对方入门课就涵盖了所需的先修内容（marker_led_indirect）。A由 statistics 联想到上课地点，答非所问（semantic_association_trap）。C用 Yes 回答，且说的是能否提前选课这件另一回事（wrong_question_type）。D说的是自己已经选完课，没有回答先修要求（off_topic）。

items.situation: student seeking help at the writing center
items.speaker: Where's the place to get essay help?

options.A: My essay is about coastal erosion.
options.B: I go there almost every week.
options.D: The deadline was moved to Monday.

items.explanation: 正确答案是C。直接回答了地点这一事实性问题（direct_topical）。A由 essay 联想到论文主题，没有回答地点（semantic_association_trap）。B回答的是「你多久去一次」，不是「在哪里」（wrong_question_type）。D说的是截止日期，与问路无关（off_topic）。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: Have you eaten at the new noodle place?

options.A: The noodles are made every morning.
options.D: Just once, and the line was long.

items.explanation: 正确答案是D。以 Just 开头，既回应了「去过没有」，又补上排队很长这一有用信息（marker_led_indirect）。A由 noodles 联想到面条怎么做，绕开了问题（semantic_association_trap）。B答的是早饭吃没吃，问的却是有没有去过那家店（wrong_question_type）。C换成说别人在那里打工，是另一个话题（off_topic）。

items.situation: student asking about course enrollment or prerequisites
items.speaker: Did you get into the seminar you wanted?

options.A: They're adding another section next week.
options.B: The seminar room holds twenty students.
options.C: Yes, I wanted the earlier bus.
options.D: She teaches two courses this term.

items.explanation: 正确答案是A。不直接答上没上成，而是给出更关键的消息——下周要加开一个班，等于把话题推到真正要紧的地方（context_shift）。B由 seminar 联想到教室容量，是无用信息（semantic_association_trap）。C误解了 wanted，把想选的课听成想赶的班车（misinterpretation）。D说的是老师带几门课，与是否选上无关（off_topic）。

items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: I didn't realize the pool closes that early.

options.A: The pool is being cleaned tomorrow.
options.B: How late did you show up?
options.D: I left my towel in the locker.

items.explanation: 正确答案是B。用一个反问推进对话，先弄清对方到底几点才到（counter_question）。A由 pool 联想到清洁安排，没有回应对方扑空这件事（semantic_association_trap）。C用 Yes 回答，且说的是自己周末游泳的习惯（wrong_question_type）。D说毛巾落在柜子里，是另一件事（off_topic）。
